text:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] Canary us-west-2 / model-serving-v2 — 5xx rate 8.4% (1m). Rollout id=ro-2026-04-11-17, traffic=20%. https://grafana/redwood/d/rollouts
Alice: paging, I'm on it.
Alice: checking canary dashboard + logs now.
Bob: seeing a big tail of 502s from inference nodes, looks like mem growth around kv cache change.
Jordan: I pushed the new kv-cache kernel opt in the canary config ~5m ago.
Alice: do we have abort flag? what are abort thresholds?
Bob: runbook says >5% 5xx for 5m -> abort. This hit 8% in the last 1m.
Jordan: ok i can flip the flag. ff.kv_cache_enabled=false
Claire: any customer impact yet? support hasn't received tickets, but we should pre-empt.
Sam: product note — low-latency customers might see errors; flag any orgs hitting errors >0.5%
IncidentBot: PagerDuty: paged @alice, @bob. Runbook: https://wiki/redwood/canary-rollout-runbook
Alice: executing quickstop: setting rollout traffic=0 for ro-2026-04-11-17
Bob: running: `redwood rollout update --id ro-2026-04-11-17 --traffic 0`
Jordan: flipping feature flag: `ffctl set kv_cache_enabled false --env canary`
Alice: done — traffic now 0%. watch metrics.
Bob: tailing logs: 5xx dropping. current 5xx rate 0.9% and falling.
Jordan: reverting kernel changes on canary nodes as well, rolling restart started.
Claire: sending initial incident note to customers: "We detected elevated 5xx on a new canary rollout, traffic cut, rollback in progress. Monitoring." -> sent to top 10 orgs.
Sam: good. keep me posted if any customers see persistent errors.
Alice: handing off to SRE for postmortem and cleanup. I'm stepping out in 10. @Bob you take primary?
Bob: ack — I’ll open an incident doc and assign follow-ups (postmortem, root cause: kv-cache kernel opt + memory pressure).
IncidentBot: Alert resolved (duration 9m). Metrics stabilized below threshold.
Alice: thanks team — postmortem owners: Bob, Jordan. Claire will coordinate customer comms.
Bob: will create postmortem link in #incidents and reference rollback command + logs.
Jordan: adding a test to rollout CI to catch the kv-cache kernel combo.
Claire: I'll push follow-up customer note once postmortem is drafted.
Sam: moving to monitor mode, threshold for re-open = sustained 1% 5xx for 5m.
Alice: handing off final on-call to @Bob.
Bob: taking over. Marking thread handoff complete.
